title: Partner portal: the same kind of call, spoken like a real one

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Hey Tom! Can you hear me okay?

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Yep, loud and clear. Hey Sofia. How was the weekend?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: [laughs] Short. Way too short. You?

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: [sighs] Moving apartments. Don't ask.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Oof. Okay, I won't. [laughs] So, um, quick intro for the recording. I'm Sofia, I'm the product lead on the partner portal.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: And I'm Tom, I'm doing the backend. Well... mostly the backend.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: [laughs] Mostly. Okay, so I just wanna go through what's left before the launch, 'cause it's getting... close. Like, really close.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Yeah. So, first thing, the partner team is still waiting on the API docs. They pinged me again this morning, actually.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Ugh, right. Can you get those over to them? Like, by Wednesday?

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. I'll send them the docs by Wednesday. That's fine.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Does that include the auth part? They kept asking about tokens.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Yeah, the whole thing. Auth, webhooks, all of it.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Oh, and while I'm in there, we could also add a dark mode. People keep asking for it, and it's honestly not that much work, I could just—

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: [jumping in] [laughs] I know, I know. I'd rather not. Not this release, let's keep it tight.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Fair. Fair enough.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Okay, next one. The staging demo. Can you have it up by Thursday?

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Thursday... yeah. Thursday works.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Great. And I'll book the big room for the client workshop, the one on the fourth—

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: [jumping in] The one with the projector that never works?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: [laughs] Yes. That one. I'll book it anyway.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: [laughs] Okay.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Um, one more thing. The privacy policy page has to be updated before launch. Like, it really has to.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Yeah, no, that definitely needs to happen.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Oh, and do we even know if they need single sign-on? SSO?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Honestly? No idea. Nobody's asked them yet.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Hm. Okay. Also, uh, the flaky tests in the payment module... I'll try to look at them this week, but, you know, no promises.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: That's fine. Whenever you can.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Actually, wait, sorry, going back to the staging demo. Thursday's too tight. The database migration is gonna eat, like, the whole week. Can we say Monday instead?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Is the migration okay, though? Should I be worried?

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Nah, it's fine. It's just slow. Lots of data.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Okay. Monday... yeah, okay. Let's make it Monday.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Cool. Thank you.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Oh, and I just got a message from the client. They wanna do the workshop online now, so... I won't book the room after all.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: [laughs] The projector lives another day.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: [laughs] Exactly. Okay, I think that's everything. Thanks, Tom.

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Thanks, Sofia. Talk soon.
